newsitem.title: CANADA: CWB adds second specialty wheat to 97/98 delivery.
newsitem.headline: CWB adds second specialty wheat to 97/98 delivery.

text.p: Canadian Wheat Board said Monday it would add a second specialty wheat to its variety-specific production and delivery program in the 1997/98 (Aug/July) marketing year.
One specialty wheat, Glenlea of the Canada Western Extra Strong (CWES) variety, was offered in the current year and will also be offered in the coming year, the CWB said.
Glenlea is used in frozen dough.
AC Karma, a variety of the Canada Prairie Spring White (CPSW) class, will also be offered for pre-seeding sign-up.
AC Karma is used to make Asian noodles.
Qualifying grades of the pedigree seed were set at No1 and N02 in each class, the CWB said.
Glenlea grading No1 or No2 CWES with 12.5 percent protein or more will receive protein premiums.
